toolGrip.poseStatusNote: Finger angles were solved against the representative shaft below: axis through the runtime's shared contact line V9_RIGHT_HAND_CONTACT (src/view/WizardScene.tsx, read-only) along glTF Z at rest, hand-relative as rightHandToolMountFor mounts it against the rest Socket.RightHand. If that constant or the mount regime changes, re-run author_v9_game.py with RUNTIME_CONTACT_GLB updated; bones, weights, channels and the neutral hand do not depend on it.

runtimeContract.mount: hand-relative: rightHandToolMountFor(mainHand, restSocket) places the shaft axis through the contact once, in rest Socket.RightHand space; carry along avatar -Z (axe/pick/wand) or +Z (spade)

toolGrip.channelRule: finger bones only, constant two-key clip; no Hand.R, arm, Hips, Root, robe/tunic weight or face channel. On-foot and ride clips carry no finger channels, so ToolGrip layered at weight 1 only closes the fingers. GripRight stays at weight 0 and unanimated.
toolGrip.usage: play ToolGrip (loop, weight 1) alongside the locomotion clip only while a main-hand tool is equipped; stop it to return to the approved open hand
toolGrip.curlAxis: each finger bone's local +X (palm-side roll); positive curls toward the palm; the thumb rolls toward the fingers and palm

representativeShaft.placementRule: axis through the runtime contact line (handle to the back, head forward, along glTF Z at rest), hand-relative; the hand is not moved toward the tool and the open hand must clear the shaft

glbChannelPass.rule: post-export: finger channels removed from every clip except ToolGrip; ToolGrip keeps only the ten finger rotation channels (the NLA exporter bakes every bone into every track). Remaining channels are the exporter's own output; orphaned accessors/bufferViews pruned with indices remapped, binary blob untouched.

glbTimeline.rule: post-export: Run's time accessors are shifted so the first key is t=0 and the closing (loop-matching) key is cycleFrames/fps; LoopRepeat then has no held first frame. Output values, channel set, interpolation and every other clip are untouched. Idle/Walk/Turn/Jump and the ride clips keep the exporter's 1/24 s start (the runtime drives Idle/Walk by phase; ride clips must keep the mount's durations).

TurnLeft.yawDirection: positive yaw, A key (counter-clockwise from above)
TurnLeft.steppingOrder: left foot steps out (frames 1-16), right foot follows (17-32)

hipsTrack.note: offsets are Hips bone-local; the bone axis is tilted about 3 deg, so a vertical offset couples about 5 percent into glTF forward (-Z)

TurnRight.yawDirection: negative yaw, D key (clockwise from above)
TurnRight.steppingOrder: right foot steps out (frames 1-16), left foot follows (17-32)

hipsTrack.note: offsets are Hips bone-local; the bone axis is tilted about 3 deg, so a vertical offset couples about 5 percent into glTF forward (-Z)

stepTurnClips.mirror: TurnRight is the exact mirror of TurnLeft: L/R bones swapped, Y and Z rotations and Hips X location negated

jumpClip.rootRule: Hips location is the body's own crouch/extension offset (vertical, zero horizontal); airborne frames keep it at 0. No world-space arc is baked: game physics owns world Y.

jumpClip.runtimeHint: play takeoff 0 to 0.33 on jump input, hold or ping-pong inside tuckHold 0.44 to 0.62 while airborne, play 0.62 to 1.0 on ground contact
jumpClip.poseSpaceNote: between push and tuckHold (0.33 to 0.44) and in reach (0.62 to 0.78) the extended feet dip up to about 2 cm below the root floor plane; the character is airborne in physics there, so this is not ground penetration

hipsTrack.note: Hips bone-local offsets equal the mount seat delta (glTF x, y, z) for the same frame; the rider follows the saddle, no drift

rideClips.riderSeatOffsetRule: mount-local translation of the rider root (its floor origin), no rotation: Seat.glbPosition + (0, -0.823, +0.02 forward); rider and mount both face -Z. Apply as RIDER_SEAT_OFFSET in the workbench; the ride clips then put the pelvis on the seat.

staticPose.solver: 2-bone IK hip/knee/ankle to the stirrup tread + ankle height with the knee pole; foot aimed level; 2-bone IK upper arm/forearm to the rein end minus 12.5 cm along the hand; hand aimed along the rein with the palm turned down-and-in

rideClips.gripRight: weight 0 in every clip and never animated; the open Basis hand rests on the rein ends
rideClips.heldTools: the workbench hides held tools in riding mode; sockets are unchanged

drapeMorph.name: RideDrape
drapeMorph.weightRule: 1.0 across RideIdle/RideWalk/RideRun, 0.0 across all on-foot clips (keyed in every clip)
drapeMorph.method: skirt rows below z=0.98 released from the pose and settled as position-based cloth (gravity steps, grid and diagonal distance constraints at the authored rest lengths, 1.6 cm push-out from the mount body/saddle/blanket and the rider's trousers/boots), then inverted through the seated skinning matrices into a rest-space offset

fit.note: rideIdleFrame1 is measured against the rest-pose mount; animated frames (both rigs moving) are measured by render_sedgehorn.py and recorded in sedgehorn_manifest.json riderFit

footwearVariants.runtimeRule: show V9_feet when gear.boots is false, V9_boots when true; both nodes are exported visible
footwearVariants.feetSource: CC0 base-mesh feet and lower shins below z=0.58 m, skinned to Thigh/Shin/Foot per side

gripMorph.usageNote: User rejected the closed GripRight pose. Game and workbench keep the original open Basis hand at weight 0 for every tool; never activate this morph.

compromises: No Subdivision or Solidify on the game mesh (V9 bust renders used subsurf render level 2 at 300k triangles); cloth is single-sided sheets with double-sided materials, brows and brooch keep a small Solidify.
Procedural bump, sheen, coat and subsurface shader detail does not export to glTF; flat PBR factors only. The hair root-to-tip gradient is baked to vertex colours (COLOR_0).
Below the mantle the robe is torso-fitted with separate sleeves; the V9 bust robe wrapped the arms as a poncho.
Skinning is smooth distance falloff, tuned for the Idle/Walk/Run/Turn/TurnLeft/TurnRight/Jump amplitudes, not hand-painted weights.

Riding: the robe and tunic skirt use the RideDrape morph (solved once for the seated pose) instead of cloth simulation; it is keyed 1 in the ride clips and 0 elsewhere, so a blend between an on-foot and a ride clip crossfades the drape.
Run is in place with no root motion or foot IK; the stance foot dips a few centimetres through the floor at mid-stance.
V9_feet and V9_boots are both exported visible; the runtime must toggle them (feet sole and boot sole share the floor plane).

settings.v9MatchCamera: 85 mm, 36 mm sensor, pivot (0,0,1.92), distance 2.125 m, 512x512, V9 lights

settings.closeCamera: orthographic, ortho_scale 0.42, centred 3.5 cm lateral of the posed shaft axis point, 512x512
settings.proxyShaft: render-only cylinder, radius 0.0475 m, 1.4 m long, grip 0.4 m from the trailing end, iron head block forward; axis through the runtime contact (manifest toolGrip.representativeShaft.axisPointRestBlender), hand-relative (rides Hand.R with its rotation) as rightHandToolMountFor mounts it
settings.armRegime: the clip's own right arm (clipArm); the runtime's 70 % equipped carry blend toward rest is not applied here
